entries.title: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with scalable resolution/settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The updated Windows PC release is the best fidelity/capture route: the 2022 update added new content and quality-of-life features across platforms, while PC keeps the strongest display/capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Man of Medan on Steam and play the fully updated Windows PC build. Use PS5/Xbox Series for console preference or Switch for portable play.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the later content/QOL update and PC capture/display flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/capture route with no sourced content loss.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console releases, later patched with update features.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route, but no sourced content advantage over updated PC.
skip: improved console route, but no sourced content or fidelity advantage over updated PC.
skip: portable route, but no sourced exclusive content advantage over updated PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The current-generation and Switch releases expand platform access, but the updated PC release retains the content updates without a sourced content loss.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2022 update added new content and quality-of-life features to older platforms while PS5/Xbox Series versions launched with enhanced visuals; this is an update path, not a separate remake.

entries.title: The Dark Pictures: Switchback VR

emulation.notes: Requires PS5 and PlayStation VR2 hardware.

primary.why: Switchback VR is an official Dark Pictures VR spin-off built for PlayStation VR2, making PS5 with PS VR2 the only sourced and highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Dark Pictures: Switchback VR on PlayStation Store and play on PlayStation 5 with a PlayStation VR2 headset.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 / PlayStation VR2 release using PS VR2 headset features.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced platform route and the intended VR presentation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform or content split exists in sourced public data.

entries.remaster_caveats: VR spin-off, not a remake/remaster of an anthology episode.
